Hissing Mantle.name: Hissing Mantle
Hissing Mantle.description: The user sweats a coat of strong acid over their whole body and holds it there. Until the scene ends or the user lets it dry, anyone who grabs, grapples or strikes them bare-handed takes corrosive damage and must let go, ropes, tape and cuffs on them dissolve, and wooden or plastic weapons that hit them pit and break; their own clothes dissolve too unless acid-proof. Strain: heavy.
